verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-meem
Tanzeelul-kitaabi laa rayba feehi min rabbil-aalameen
Am yaqooloona iftaraahu bal huwal-haqqu min rabbika litundhira qawman maa ataahum min nadheerin min qablika la-allahum yahtadoon
Allaahul-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wa maa baynahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin thumma istawaa alal-arshi maa lakum min doonihi min waliyyin wa laa shafee'in afalaa tatadhakkaroon
Yudabbirul-amra minas-samaa'i ilal-ardi thumma ya'ruju ilayhi fee yawmin kaana miqdaaruhu alfa sanatin mimmaa ta'uddoon
Dhaalika aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadatil-azeezur-Raheem
Al-ladhee ahsana kulla shay'in khalaqahu wa bada'a khalqal-insaani min teen
Thumma ja'ala naslahu min sulaalatin min maa'in maheen
Thumma sawwaahu wa nafakha feehi min roohihi wa ja'ala lakumus-sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idata qaleelan maa tashkuroon
Wa qaaloo a'idhaa dalalnaa fil-ardi a'innaa lafee khalqin jadeedin bal hum biliqaa'i rabbihim kaafiroon
Qul yatawaffaakum malakul-mawtil-ladhee wukkila bikum thumma ilaa rabbikum turja'oon
Wa law taraa idhil-mujrimoona naakisoo ru'oosihim inda rabbihim rabbanaa absarnaa wa sami'naa farji'naa na'mal saalihan innaa mooqinoon
Wa law shi'naa la-aataynaa kulla nafsin hudaahaa wa laakin haqqal-qawlu minnee la-amla'anna jahannama minal-jinnati wan-naasi ajma'een
Fadhooqoo bimaa naseetum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa innaa naseenaakum wa dhooqoo adhaabal-khuldi bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
Innamaa yu'minu bi-aayaatinal-ladheena idhaa dhukkiroo bihaa kharroo sujjadan wa sabbahoo bihamdi rabbihim wa hum laa yastakbiroon
Tatajaafaa junoobuhum anil-madaaji'i yad'oona rabbahum khawfan wa tama'an wa mimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Falaa ta'lamu nafsun maa ukhfiya lahum min qurrati a'yunin jazaa'an bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
Afaman kaana mu'minan kaman kaana faasiqan laa yastawoon
Ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati falahum jannaatul-ma'waa nuzulan bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
Wa ammal-ladheena fasaqoo fama'waahumun-naaru kullamaa araadoo an yakhrujoo minhaa u'eedoo feehaa wa qeela lahum dhooqoo adhaaban-naaril-ladhee kuntum bihi tukadhdhiboon
Wa lanudheeqannahum minal-adhaabil-adnaa doonal-adhaabil-akbari la-allahum yarji'oon
Wa man azlamu mimman dhukkira bi-aayaati rabbihi thumma a'rada anhaa innaa minal-mujrimeena muntaqimoon
Wa laqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba falaa takun fee miryatin min liqaa'ihi wa ja'alnaahu hudan libanee israa'eel
Wa ja'alnaa minhum a'immatan yahdoona bi-amrinaa lammaa sabaroo wa kaanoo bi-aayaatinaa yooqinoon
Inna rabbaka huwa yafsilu baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
Awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknaa min qablihim minal-qurooni yamshoona fee masaakinihim inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin afalaa yasma'oon
Awalam yaraw annaa nasooqul-maa'a ilal-ardil-juruzi fanukhriju bihi zar'an ta'kulu minhu an'aamuhum wa anfusuhum afalaa yubsiroon
Wa yaqooloona mataa haadhal-fathu in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul yawmal-fathi laa yanfa'ul-ladheena kafaroo eemaanuhum wa laa hum yunzaroon
Fa-a'rid anhum wantazir innahum muntaziroon
